ops_per_sample: ~45 flops per channel: LFO (sinPar ~10 / tri / parabola / random lerp), 1 ms delay slew, 1 Hermite read (~20), feedback write, DC block (~4), mix ramp (~5). Mono-in = 1 channel, stereo-in = 2.
notes: Re-implementation of McCurdy Flanger.csd (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Thru-zero (default, v1) means MIX=0 outputs the INVERTED dry delayed 1 sample, as in v1; set THRUZ=0 for a plain flanger (MIX=0 = dry). Min loop delay 2 samples (offset 20 us is clamped, as the Csound opcode clamps to 1 sample). fb clamped +-0.95. Mono in -> mono out.
